Character status

Inspect your hero to check wounds and active effects.

The character panel has views for health, attributes, equipment and effects.

Controls depend on your keyboard, gamepad and camera settings. The in-game guide shows your current bindings.

Classic edition reference

These original pages describe classic mouse and keyboard controls. Use the guidance above for current settings and gamepad controls.

Information window

The Information window (currently highlighted) gives you details about the game characters. If you want details on any character, just place the cursor over him/her. The Information window defaults to giving details on your own character (a.k.a. "the Hero").
The Information window has several modes. See the next screen for more on each one.

Note: To open/close the Information window use the (currently highlighted) triangle button at the upper-left.

Modes

The Information window has several modes. To switch between them use the buttons at its left edge, or use the keyboard. Here are the modes and a description:
General view: shows general information about the character's view (<,> key)
Hit locations: shows what damage has been inflicted on his/her different body parts (<.> key)
Attributes: shows the character's attributes (</> key)
Spell effects: shows what spells are currently affecting the character and the time (in seconds) remaining before the effect wears off (<'> key)
